methodology.hypothesis: The measured account risk is concentrated despite more nominal factor labels; fees alone do not explain the 2020 held-equity loss and gold is not a guaranteed defense. Test joint portfolio downside allocation with an explicit observed growth-opportunity constraint, rather than marginal sleeve risk balance, covariance-only diversification or another exit overlay.
methodology.inputs: Use only the already admitted fourteen-asset historical data and six registered economic-family ETFs. At actual completed XNYS month ends, use the latest252 completed daily adjusted-close returns including that close and the actual252-session price ratios. No old strategy targets or full-sample diagnostic risk shares enter the allocation.
methodology.core: Treat the equal-six-family core as one jointly observed return sleeve, using the arithmetic mean of its six fund daily returns and arithmetic mean of their252-session total-return scores. This is a linear scenario exposure, not an invented fund price or a replayed core account. Scatter its chosen weight equally back to the six actual ETFs.
methodology.opportunity: Each sleeve score is its observed252-session total return minus actual BIL over the same horizon. The hurdle is the greater of SPY and QQQ cash-relative scores. It is an observed momentum-opportunity proxy, not a forecast or a claim that future net benchmark goals are satisfied.
methodology.standby: If the benchmark hurdle is nonpositive, hold the invested budget in BIL. If the strictly positive hurdle exceeds the analytical maximum feasible score over the declared convex sleeve set, also hold BIL with an explicit opportunity-unavailable record. This is a predefined economic condition; missing/invalid data, numerical infeasibility inconsistent with that analytical bound, or solver failure must stop, never fall back to equal weights or cash.
methodology.joint_tail: Otherwise minimize empirical5%expected shortfall of daily gross portfolio losses using the linear epigraph formulation over all252 joint return scenarios. Include actual BIL returns in risk, not synthetic interest. Fractional tail mass is retained. A negative sampled tail loss is not proof of risk-free exposure and never permits leverage.
methodology.constraints: Nonnegative sleeve weights sum toone. The factor core must be at least as large as the SOXX sleeve: reuse the prior thematic half-equity share only as a model-specific upper bound, not a fixed allocation or a permanent user constraint. Aggregate equity may vary fromzero toall invested capital; gold, intermediate/long Treasuries and BIL are chosen jointly. The total actual ETF target is98%,with2%idlecash. No stock-level PIT definitions are substituted.
methodology.tie_break: First solve minimum joint tail loss. Then maximize the same observed opportunity score subject to the primary risk optimum plus the frozen numerical slack. Both LPs require independent primal/dual/complementarity checks and exact sorted-tail reevaluation. The fixed solver and deterministic input order resolve remaining degeneracy; no fitted regularization or weight grid.
methodology.timing: Construct targets only at genuine completed month ends after253price observations, carry them otherwise, and never treat a truncated final row as month end. Use the original funded execution and pure0.025actual-holdings band on each close,one pending request without replacement/cancellation,5bpnext-openbase and20bpextra-sessionstress,USD1tickets,freshUSD10000,originalRF andinitialdrawdownpeak,no terminal liquidation.
methodology.prior_art: The supplemental policy review identified already tested unleveraged covariance risk budgeting and maximum diversification, as well as earlier marginal downside balancing and learned return models. This study does not rename those: it has no covariance-risk objective or fitted forecasting model, and jointly minimizes portfolio tail scenarios while imposing an observed stronger-benchmark opportunity hurdle. Existing failures and queued W42plans remain unchanged.
methodology.selection: One fixed construction chosen after186exposed completed configurations and saved risk/prior-art review. No weights are taken from the ex-post variance contributions. All four original paths and the existing netSharpe>1,netCAGR>12%,DD<=15%,SPY/QQQ and extra stress-vs-base-SPY gates remain; there is no independent holdout or total research quota.
methodology.limitations: Historical momentum can reverse and sampled tails can miss new shocks. Monthly estimation, order delay, costs, drift and opportunity standby can lower returns or breach drawdown. The core/thematic constraint may make the opportunity hurdle unavailable. Expected shortfall is not a guarantee on maximum drawdown. Current mandates and cached fund history are not complete historical stock-level PIT or independent alpha evidence.
